readings: areset is an asynchronous active-high reset: state immediately becomes 2'b01 while areset=1, independent of clk.
areset is sampled on the positive clk edge (synchronous reset), so state only changes at a clk posedge despite the word asynchronous.
areset resets asynchronously only on the positive edge of areset itself.
Reset dominates: if areset=1 while train_valid=1, state is forced to 2'b01 regardless of train_taken.
Training dominates or takes precedence: when train_valid=1, state increments/decrements according to train_taken even if areset=1.
state is the registered counter output, so train inputs sampled at a clk edge affect state only in the next cycle.
state is the combinational next-state/counter value, so it reflects the updated counter in the same cycle the train inputs are valid.
state is undefined/X until areset is asserted.
state powers up at 2'b01 (weakly not-taken) even if areset is never asserted.
